The main takeaway from our work is that

the performance of an application over WWANs is significantly affected by the optimizations performed at the application layer, and that the performance of the optimizations is dependent on the characteristics of the WWANs.
, in order to achieve a significant application performance improvement over WWANs, it is necessary to combine optimizations performed at different protocol layers.
